name: Llima
source:
Interest: Nature, Swimming & Lima Beans

I did not know the existence of Lima Beans until someone mentioned it when I showed Llima's character design. I ended up using it as her favorite food, as well as lime, because lima is the Spanish word for lime.

[From in-game character profiles description]
